# SB-1003 Safety bulletin: arc flash at the induction power cabinet

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-HT02

Hazard description
An arc flash incident occurred at the induction power cabinet on EQ-P2-L3-HT02 while performing routine inspection and thermocouple replacement activities. The event produced molten metal and an energy release within the cabinet enclosure, presenting burn and blast hazards to personnel performing work at the cabinet front and nearby. Root-cause analysis identified energized components exposed during inspection and inadequate isolation and grounding procedures during thermocouple handling as contributing factors. Personnel were protected by PPE but experienced minor thermal exposure; material and tooling sustained damage that required follow-up repair.

Affected equipment
This bulletin applies to EQ-P2-L3-HT02 (Machining heat treat furnace #2) and all associated induction power cabinets and harnessing on line P2-L3 at Plant P2. The thermocouple calibration interval for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 50 days. Technicians, maintenance, and operations personnel assigned to EQ-P2-L3-HT02 or performing work on its power cabinet must follow the required controls below.

Required controls
- De-energize and verify zero energy state at the induction power cabinet before opening the enclosure. Use applied verification per SOP-P2-L3-02.  
- Place lockout/tagout on all incoming power feeds and verify isolation continuity per MM-P2-L3-HT02.  
- Bond and ground thermocouple leads to chassis before disconnection and reconnection to prevent capacitive discharge. Document bonding actions in the maintenance record per MM-P2-L3-HT02-S3.  
- Restrict entry to a two-person team when any panel is open; second person must remain at a safe distance with communication line.  
- Use arc-rated PPE for exposures inside the cabinet boundary; conduct a pre-job briefing to confirm roles and emergency procedures.  
- Report all anomalies and near-misses using existing incident reporting channels and reference this bulletin and the cited documents for corrective tasks.

Effective date
Effective immediately upon release.
